Name: Gifts From Vincent - Playful Letters and Random Gifts
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
From rocks to animal products, receive the most random gifts from Vincent, a simple and fun friendship, and he also rewards you for the gifts he received from you. Not everything is useful, but he's just a child.

[b][size=4]✨ Features[/size][/b]

✔ Unique gifts for every friendship level
✔ Character-themed rewards
✔ Better and better gifts with each friendship level
✔ Fully lore-friendly gift selections
✔ Compatible with existing saves
✔ Progress reset upon updating
